exact_tokens: Add a minimal command-classification / normalization contract to the command-definition layer: `command_kind` (shell_view | navigation_wrapper | domain_action); optional `normalization` with `kind` (wrapper | deprecated_alias) and exactly one target field: `normalizes_to_contract` for wrappers OR `alias_of_command_id` for deprecated aliases
Keep wrapper metadata contract-level and narrow: point to the canonical primitive family; do not restate route payload structure there
Deprecated alias metadata should remain explicit and separate because it implies lifecycle/removal expectations that wrapper commands do not have.

Extend `GATE-010` to verify: wrapper commands marked as normalizing to the same primitive do not diverge in handler semantics unexpectedly; deprecated aliases resolve to real canonical command IDs; normalization metadata is internally consistent with the command kind
notes: The catalog and contract layer need a minimal normalization model. Three distinct concepts: public command ID, canonical primitive contract, deprecated alias. Wiring matrix should stay lean — verification logic goes in gate layer (GATE-010 extension), not repeated per wiring row.
Plans/evidence.schema.json (not in valid Plans/*.md list) was also cited as lacking structured normalization/alias evidence slots — gate expansion must address this.
